verdicts.rationale: REST v2 entities/insert endpoint accepts non-JSON string values for fields declared as dataType JSON without validation. Source code (utils.go:760-761) shows JSON case in checkAndSetData() directly converts input string to []byte without json.Unmarshal validation, unlike other types (FloatVector, Int32, etc.) that validate and return errors on invalid input. This matches the known REST v2 data type handling blindspot pattern (26 historical instances). The API violates contract constraints (milvus_type_json_001) requiring JSON fields to contain valid JSON data. Query verification confirms the literal string "plain_string" was stored, not converted to JSON. This is a true defect - JSON field validation is missing in REST v2 insert path.
